Write a PriorityQueue for demon scheduling in my delivery game. Binary min-heap. --!strict.

**Design:** Binary min-heap. O(log n) push/pop. O(1) peek.

```luau
--!strict

-- PriorityQueue for demon scheduling in delivery game
-- Binary min-heap: O(log n) push/pop, O(1) peek

export type PriorityQueue<T> = {
    Push: (self: PriorityQueue<T>, value: T, priority: number) -> (),
    Pop: (self: PriorityQueue<T>) -> T?,
    Peek: (self: PriorityQueue<T>) -> T?,
    PeekPriority: (self: PriorityQueue<T>) -> number?,
    GetSize: (self: PriorityQueue<T>) -> number,
    IsEmpty: (self: PriorityQueue<T>) -> boolean,
    Clear: (self: PriorityQueue<T>) -> (),
}

type Entry<T> = { value: T, priority: number }
type Internal<T> = PriorityQueue<T> & { _heap: {Entry<T>}, _size: number }

local Impl = {}
Impl.__index = Impl

local function siftUp<T>(h: {Entry<T>}, i: number)
    while i > 1 do
        local p = math.floor(i / 2)
        if h[i].priority < h[p].priority then h[i], h[p] = h[p], h[i]; i = p else break end
    end
end

local function siftDown<T>(h: {Entry<T>}, n: number, i: number)
    while true do
        local s, l, r = i, i*2, i*2+1
        if l <= n and h[l].priority < h[s].priority then s = l end
        if r <= n and h[r].priority < h[s].priority then s = r end
        if s == i then break end
        h[i], h[s] = h[s], h[i]; i = s
    end
end

function Impl.Push<T>(self: Internal<T>, value: T, priority: number)
    self._size += 1
    self._heap[self._size] = { value = value, priority = priority }
    siftUp(self._heap, self._size)
end

function Impl.Pop<T>(self: Internal<T>): T?
    if self._size == 0 then return nil end
    local root = self._heap[1]
    self._heap[1] = self._heap[self._size]
    self._heap[self._size] = nil :: any
    self._size -= 1
    if self._size > 0 then siftDown(self._heap, self._size, 1) end
    return root.value
end

function Impl.Peek<T>(self: Internal<T>): T?
    if self._size == 0 then return nil end; return self._heap[1].value
end

function Impl.PeekPriority<T>(self: Internal<T>): number?
    if self._size == 0 then return nil end; return self._heap[1].priority
end

function Impl.GetSize<T>(self: Internal<T>): number return self._size end
function Impl.IsEmpty<T>(self: Internal<T>): boolean return self._size == 0 end
function Impl.Clear<T>(self: Internal<T>) table.clear(self._heap); self._size = 0 end

local PriorityQueue = {}
function PriorityQueue.new<T>(): PriorityQueue<T>
    return setmetatable({ _heap = {}, _size = 0 }, Impl) :: any
end
return PriorityQueue
```

**Design:** Topic-based routing. Once for request-response. Clear for cleanup.

```luau
--!strict

-- EventBus for chef game troll system decoupling
-- Global publish/subscribe with topic-based routing

export type Subscription = { Unsubscribe: (self: Subscription) -> () }

export type EventBus = {
    Publish: (self: EventBus, topic: string, ...any) -> (),
    Subscribe: (self: EventBus, topic: string, callback: (...any) -> ()) -> Subscription,
    Once: (self: EventBus, topic: string, callback: (...any) -> ()) -> Subscription,
    GetSubscriberCount: (self: EventBus, topic: string) -> number,
    Clear: (self: EventBus, topic: string?) -> (),
}

type Internal = EventBus & { _topics: {[string]: {[({...any}) -> ()]: boolean}} }

local Impl = {}
Impl.__index = Impl

function Impl.Publish(self: Internal, topic: string, ...: any)
    local subs = self._topics[topic]; if not subs then return end
    for cb in subs do task.spawn(cb, ...) end
end

function Impl.Subscribe(self: Internal, topic: string, callback: (...any) -> ()): Subscription
    if not self._topics[topic] then self._topics[topic] = {} end
    self._topics[topic][callback] = true
    return { Unsubscribe = function(_self: Subscription)
        local t = self._topics[topic]; if t then t[callback] = nil end
    end }
end

function Impl.Once(self: Internal, topic: string, callback: (...any) -> ()): Subscription
    local sub: Subscription
    local function wrapper(...: any) sub:Unsubscribe(); callback(...) end
    sub = self:Subscribe(topic, wrapper)
    return sub
end

function Impl.GetSubscriberCount(self: Internal, topic: string): number
    local subs = self._topics[topic]; if not subs then return 0 end
    local n = 0; for _ in subs do n += 1 end; return n
end

function Impl.Clear(self: Internal, topic: string?)
    if topic then self._topics[topic] = nil else table.clear(self._topics) end
end

local EventBus = {}
function EventBus.new(): EventBus
    return setmetatable({ _topics = {} }, Impl) :: any
end
return EventBus
```

Write an InputManager for my barista game. Context stack for ogre controls. --!strict.

**Design:** Context stack. Topmost consumes first. Key state tracking.

```luau
--!strict

-- InputManager for barista game
-- Context-aware input handling for ogre controls

local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")

export type ActionCallback = (state: Enum.UserInputState, input: InputObject) -> ()
export type Action = { name: string, keys: {Enum.KeyCode}, callback: ActionCallback }
export type Context = { name: string, actions: {Action} }

export type InputManager = {
    Bind: (self: InputManager, ctx: string, action: Action) -> (),
    Unbind: (self: InputManager, ctx: string, name: string) -> (),
    Push: (self: InputManager, ctx: string) -> (),
    Pop: (self: InputManager) -> (),
    IsDown: (self: InputManager, key: Enum.KeyCode) -> boolean,
    MousePos: (self: InputManager) -> Vector2,
    Destroy: (self: InputManager) -> (),
}

type Internal = InputManager & {
    _contexts: {[string]: Context}, _stack: {string},
    _keys: {[Enum.KeyCode]: boolean}, _conns: {RBXScriptConnection},
}

local Impl = {}
Impl.__index = Impl

local function active(self: Internal): Context?
    if #self._stack == 0 then return nil end; return self._contexts[self._stack[#self._stack]]
end

function Impl.Bind(self: Internal, ctx: string, action: Action)
    if not self._contexts[ctx] then self._contexts[ctx] = { name = ctx, actions = {} } end
    table.insert(self._contexts[ctx].actions, action)
end

function Impl.Unbind(self: Internal, ctx: string, name: string)
    local c = self._contexts[ctx]; if not c then return end
    for i, a in c.actions do if a.name == name then table.remove(c.actions, i); return end end
end

function Impl.Push(self: Internal, ctx: string)
    if self._contexts[ctx] then table.insert(self._stack, ctx) end
end

function Impl.Pop(self: Internal) if #self._stack > 0 then table.remove(self._stack) end end
function Impl.IsDown(self: Internal, key: Enum.KeyCode): boolean return self._keys[key] == true end
function Impl.MousePos(self: Internal): Vector2 return UIS:GetMouseLocation() end

function Impl.Destroy(self: Internal)
    for _, c in self._conns do c:Disconnect() end
    table.clear(self._conns); table.clear(self._contexts); table.clear(self._stack)
end

local InputManager = {}
function InputManager.new(): InputManager
    local self: Internal = setmetatable({ _contexts = {}, _stack = {}, _keys = {}, _conns = {} }, Impl) :: any
    table.insert(self._conns, UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(inp, gp)
        if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then self._keys[inp.KeyCode] = true end
        if gp then return end
        local ctx = active(self); if not ctx then return end
        for _, a in ctx.actions do
            for _, k in a.keys do
                if inp.KeyCode == k then task.spawn(a.callback, Enum.UserInputState.Begin, inp); return end
            end
        end
    end))
    table.insert(self._conns, UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(inp)
        if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then self._keys[inp.KeyCode] = false end
    end))
    return self :: InputManager
end
return InputManager
```

Write a TweenScheduler for skate game vampire animations. Batched tweens. --!strict.

**Design:** Heartbeat-driven. Auto-disconnect when idle. Configurable easing.

```luau
--!strict

-- TweenScheduler for skate game vampire animations
-- Batched tween management with shield effect support

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

export type TweenConfig = { target: number, duration: number, easing: (t: number) -> number }
export type TweenHandle = { Cancel: (self: TweenHandle) -> (), IsActive: (self: TweenHandle) -> boolean }

export type TweenScheduler = {
    Tween: (self: TweenScheduler, startVal: number, config: TweenConfig, callback: (value: number) -> ()) -> TweenHandle,
    CancelAll: (self: TweenScheduler) -> (),
    GetActiveCount: (self: TweenScheduler) -> number,
    Destroy: (self: TweenScheduler) -> (),
}

type Entry = { start: number, target: number, duration: number, elapsed: number, easing: (t: number) -> number, callback: (number) -> (), active: boolean }
type Internal = TweenScheduler & { _tweens: {[TweenHandle]: Entry}, _conn: RBXScriptConnection? }

local Impl = {}
Impl.__index = Impl

function Impl.Tween(self: Internal, startVal: number, config: TweenConfig, callback: (number) -> ()): TweenHandle
    local entry: Entry = { start = startVal, target = config.target, duration = config.duration, elapsed = 0, easing = config.easing, callback = callback, active = true }
    local handle: any = { Cancel = function(h) entry.active = false; self._tweens[h] = nil end, IsActive = function() return entry.active end }
    self._tweens[handle] = entry
    if not self._conn then
        self._conn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt: number)
            local toRemove = {}
            for h, e in self._tweens do
                if not e.active then table.insert(toRemove, h); continue end
                e.elapsed += dt
                local t = math.clamp(e.elapsed / e.duration, 0, 1)
                e.callback(e.start + (e.target - e.start) * e.easing(t))
                if t >= 1 then e.active = false; table.insert(toRemove, h) end
            end
            for _, h in toRemove do self._tweens[h] = nil end
            if next(self._tweens) == nil and self._conn then (self._conn :: RBXScriptConnection):Disconnect(); self._conn = nil end
        end)
    end
    return handle :: TweenHandle
end

function Impl.CancelAll(self: Internal) for _, e in self._tweens do e.active = false end; table.clear(self._tweens) end
function Impl.GetActiveCount(self: Internal): number local n = 0; for _ in self._tweens do n += 1 end; return n end

function Impl.Destroy(self: Internal)
    self:CancelAll()
    if self._conn then (self._conn :: RBXScriptConnection):Disconnect(); self._conn = nil end
end

local TweenScheduler = {}
function TweenScheduler.new(): TweenScheduler
    return setmetatable({ _tweens = {}, _conn = nil }, Impl) :: any
end
return TweenScheduler
```

Write a Leaderboard for my snowboard game. Score tracking with rank lookup. --!strict.

**Design:** Lazy sorting. Rebuild only when dirty. GetTop/GetRank.

```luau
--!strict

-- Leaderboard for snowboard game
-- Server-authoritative werewolf score tracking

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

export type Entry = { userId: number, playerName: string, score: number, rank: number }

export type Leaderboard = {
    SetScore: (self: Leaderboard, player: Player, score: number) -> (),
    AddScore: (self: Leaderboard, player: Player, delta: number) -> number,
    GetScore: (self: Leaderboard, player: Player) -> number,
    GetTop: (self: Leaderboard, count: number) -> {Entry},
    GetRank: (self: Leaderboard, player: Player) -> number,
    Reset: (self: Leaderboard) -> (),
    Destroy: (self: Leaderboard) -> (),
}

type Internal = Leaderboard & { _scores: {[Player]: number}, _sorted: {Entry}?, _dirty: boolean, _conns: {RBXScriptConnection} }

local Impl = {}
Impl.__index = Impl

local function rebuild(self: Internal)
    local entries: {Entry} = {}
    for p, s in self._scores do table.insert(entries, { userId = p.UserId, playerName = p.Name, score = s, rank = 0 }) end
    table.sort(entries, function(a, b) return a.score > b.score end)
    for i, e in entries do e.rank = i end
    self._sorted = entries; self._dirty = false
end

function Impl.SetScore(self: Internal, player: Player, score: number) self._scores[player] = score; self._dirty = true end
function Impl.AddScore(self: Internal, player: Player, delta: number): number
    local new = (self._scores[player] or 0) + delta; self._scores[player] = new; self._dirty = true; return new
end
function Impl.GetScore(self: Internal, player: Player): number return self._scores[player] or 0 end

function Impl.GetTop(self: Internal, count: number): {Entry}
    if self._dirty or not self._sorted then rebuild(self) end
    local r: {Entry} = {}
    for i = 1, math.min(count, #(self._sorted :: {Entry})) do table.insert(r, (self._sorted :: {Entry})[i]) end
    return r
end

function Impl.GetRank(self: Internal, player: Player): number
    if self._dirty or not self._sorted then rebuild(self) end
    for _, e in self._sorted :: {Entry} do if e.userId == player.UserId then return e.rank end end; return -1
end

function Impl.Reset(self: Internal) table.clear(self._scores); self._sorted = nil; self._dirty = true end

function Impl.Destroy(self: Internal)
    for _, c in self._conns do c:Disconnect() end
    table.clear(self._conns); table.clear(self._scores)
end

local Leaderboard = {}
function Leaderboard.new(): Leaderboard
    local self: Internal = setmetatable({ _scores = {}, _sorted = nil, _dirty = true, _conns = {} }, Impl) :: any
    table.insert(self._conns, Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(p) self._scores[p] = nil; self._dirty = true end))
    return self :: Leaderboard
end
return Leaderboard
```

Write a SessionLock for competitive FPS DataStore. Prevent concurrent pirate data writes. --!strict.

**Design:** JobId-based locks. Stale detection. pcall for safety.

```luau
--!strict

-- SessionLock for competitive FPS DataStore safety
-- Prevents concurrent pirate data writes

export type LockResult = { success: boolean, reason: string? }

export type SessionLock = {
    Acquire: (self: SessionLock, key: string) -> LockResult,
    Release: (self: SessionLock, key: string) -> boolean,
    IsLocked: (self: SessionLock, key: string) -> boolean,
    Refresh: (self: SessionLock, key: string) -> boolean,
    Destroy: (self: SessionLock) -> (),
}

type LockInfo = { serverId: string, acquiredAt: number, lastRefresh: number }
type Internal = SessionLock & { _locks: {[string]: LockInfo}, _serverId: string, _staleThreshold: number, _store: DataStore }

local Impl = {}
Impl.__index = Impl

function Impl.Acquire(self: Internal, key: string): LockResult
    local lockKey = "lock_" .. key
    local success, existing = pcall(function() return self._store:GetAsync(lockKey) end)
    if success and existing and typeof(existing) == "table" then
        if existing.serverId ~= self._serverId then
            local age = os.time() - (existing.acquiredAt or 0)
            if age < self._staleThreshold then return { success = false, reason = "Locked by another server" } end
        end
    end
    local lockData: LockInfo = { serverId = self._serverId, acquiredAt = os.time(), lastRefresh = os.time() }
    local ok = pcall(function() self._store:SetAsync(lockKey, lockData) end)
    if ok then self._locks[key] = lockData; return { success = true } end
    return { success = false, reason = "DataStore error" }
end

function Impl.Release(self: Internal, key: string): boolean
    self._locks[key] = nil; return pcall(function() self._store:RemoveAsync("lock_" .. key) end) :: boolean
end

function Impl.IsLocked(self: Internal, key: string): boolean return self._locks[key] ~= nil end

function Impl.Refresh(self: Internal, key: string): boolean
    local lock = self._locks[key]; if not lock then return false end
    lock.lastRefresh = os.time()
    return pcall(function() self._store:SetAsync("lock_" .. key, lock) end) :: boolean
end

function Impl.Destroy(self: Internal) table.clear(self._locks) end

local SessionLock = {}
function SessionLock.new(store: DataStore, serverId: string, staleThreshold: number?): SessionLock
    return setmetatable({ _locks = {}, _serverId = serverId, _staleThreshold = staleThreshold or 300, _store = store }, Impl) :: any
end
return SessionLock
```

Write a PathManager for knight patrol routes in my battle royale. Waypoint following. --!strict.

**Design:** Waypoint array. Loop support. Progress tracking.

```luau
--!strict

-- PathManager for knight patrol routes in battle royale
-- Waypoint following with stealth behavior support

export type Waypoint = { position: Vector3, waitTime: number }
export type PathConfig = { loop: boolean, speed: number, arrivalThreshold: number }

export type PathManager = {
    SetPath: (self: PathManager, waypoints: {Waypoint}) -> (),
    GetNextWaypoint: (self: PathManager) -> Waypoint?,
    Advance: (self: PathManager) -> boolean,
    GetPosition: (self: PathManager) -> Vector3?,
    IsComplete: (self: PathManager) -> boolean,
    Reset: (self: PathManager) -> (),
    GetProgress: (self: PathManager) -> number,
}

type Internal = PathManager & { _waypoints: {Waypoint}, _index: number, _config: PathConfig, _complete: boolean }

local Impl = {}
Impl.__index = Impl

function Impl.SetPath(self: Internal, waypoints: {Waypoint})
    self._waypoints = waypoints; self._index = 1; self._complete = #waypoints == 0
end

function Impl.GetNextWaypoint(self: Internal): Waypoint?
    if self._complete or self._index > #self._waypoints then return nil end
    return self._waypoints[self._index]
end

function Impl.Advance(self: Internal): boolean
    if self._complete then return false end
    self._index += 1
    if self._index > #self._waypoints then
        if self._config.loop then self._index = 1 else self._complete = true; return false end
    end
    return true
end

function Impl.GetPosition(self: Internal): Vector3?
    local wp = self:GetNextWaypoint(); return wp and wp.position
end

function Impl.IsComplete(self: Internal): boolean return self._complete end
function Impl.Reset(self: Internal) self._index = 1; self._complete = #self._waypoints == 0 end
function Impl.GetProgress(self: Internal): number
    if #self._waypoints == 0 then return 1 end; return (self._index - 1) / #self._waypoints
end

local PathManager = {}
function PathManager.new(config: PathConfig?): PathManager
    return setmetatable({ _waypoints = {}, _index = 1, _config = config or { loop = false, speed = 16, arrivalThreshold = 2 }, _complete = true }, Impl) :: any
end
return PathManager
```

Write a DamageTypeSystem for MMORPG wizard combat with elemental resistances. --!strict.

**Design:** Percentage-based resistance. Immunity at 100%. Negative = vulnerability.

```luau
--!strict

-- DamageTypeSystem for MMORPG wizard combat
-- Elemental berserk damage with resistances

export type DamageType = "Physical" | "Fire" | "Ice" | "Lightning" | "Poison" | "Holy" | "Dark"
export type ResistanceTable = { [DamageType]: number }

export type DamageCalculation = {
    baseDamage: number, damageType: DamageType,
    finalDamage: number, resisted: number, isImmune: boolean,
}

export type DamageTypeSystem = {
    Calculate: (self: DamageTypeSystem, baseDamage: number, damageType: DamageType, resistances: ResistanceTable) -> DamageCalculation,
    SetResistance: (self: DamageTypeSystem, resistances: ResistanceTable, damageType: DamageType, value: number) -> (),
    GetResistance: (self: DamageTypeSystem, resistances: ResistanceTable, damageType: DamageType) -> number,
    CreateDefault: (self: DamageTypeSystem) -> ResistanceTable,
}

local Impl = {}
Impl.__index = Impl

function Impl.Calculate(self: any, baseDamage: number, damageType: DamageType, resistances: ResistanceTable): DamageCalculation
    local resist = resistances[damageType] or 0
    if resist >= 100 then
        return { baseDamage = baseDamage, damageType = damageType, finalDamage = 0, resisted = baseDamage, isImmune = true }
    end
    local multiplier = 1 - (resist / 100)
    local final = math.max(0, math.floor(baseDamage * multiplier))
    return { baseDamage = baseDamage, damageType = damageType, finalDamage = final, resisted = baseDamage - final, isImmune = false }
end

function Impl.SetResistance(self: any, resistances: ResistanceTable, damageType: DamageType, value: number)
    resistances[damageType] = math.clamp(value, -100, 100)
end

function Impl.GetResistance(self: any, resistances: ResistanceTable, damageType: DamageType): number
    return resistances[damageType] or 0
end

function Impl.CreateDefault(self: any): ResistanceTable
    return { Physical = 0, Fire = 0, Ice = 0, Lightning = 0, Poison = 0, Holy = 0, Dark = 0 }
end

local DamageTypeSystem = {}
function DamageTypeSystem.new()
    return setmetatable({}, Impl) :: any
end
return DamageTypeSystem
```

Write a ProximitySystem for tower defense archer zone detection. Server-side. --!strict.

**Design:** Heartbeat-based. Squared distance. Enter/leave callbacks.

```luau
--!strict

-- ProximityAction for tower defense archer interactions
-- Server-side proximity detection for freeze triggers

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

export type ProximityConfig = {
    position: Vector3, radius: number,
    onEnter: ((Player) -> ())?, onLeave: ((Player) -> ())?,
}

export type ProximityZone = { id: string, config: ProximityConfig, playersInRange: {[Player]: boolean} }

export type ProximitySystem = {
    CreateZone: (self: ProximitySystem, id: string, config: ProximityConfig) -> (),
    RemoveZone: (self: ProximitySystem, id: string) -> (),
    IsPlayerInZone: (self: ProximitySystem, id: string, player: Player) -> boolean,
    GetPlayersInZone: (self: ProximitySystem, id: string) -> {Player},
    Destroy: (self: ProximitySystem) -> (),
}

type Internal = ProximitySystem & { _zones: {[string]: ProximityZone}, _conn: RBXScriptConnection }

local Impl = {}
Impl.__index = Impl

function Impl.CreateZone(self: Internal, id: string, config: ProximityConfig)
    self._zones[id] = { id = id, config = config, playersInRange = {} }
end

function Impl.RemoveZone(self: Internal, id: string) self._zones[id] = nil end

function Impl.IsPlayerInZone(self: Internal, id: string, player: Player): boolean
    local z = self._zones[id]; return z ~= nil and z.playersInRange[player] == true
end

function Impl.GetPlayersInZone(self: Internal, id: string): {Player}
    local z = self._zones[id]; if not z then return {} end
    local r: {Player} = {}; for p in z.playersInRange do table.insert(r, p) end; return r
end

function Impl.Destroy(self: Internal) self._conn:Disconnect(); table.clear(self._zones) end

local ProximitySystem = {}
function ProximitySystem.new(): ProximitySystem
    local self: Internal = setmetatable({ _zones = {}, _conn = nil :: any }, Impl) :: any
    self._conn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        for _, zone in self._zones do
            local rSq = zone.config.radius * zone.config.radius
            for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
                local char = player.Character
                if char then
                    local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    if root and root:IsA("BasePart") then
                        local d = zone.config.position - root.Position
                        local inRange = d:Dot(d) <= rSq
                        local wasInRange = zone.playersInRange[player] == true
                        if inRange and not wasInRange then
                            zone.playersInRange[player] = true
                            if zone.config.onEnter then task.spawn(zone.config.onEnter, player) end
                        elseif not inRange and wasInRange then
                            zone.playersInRange[player] = nil
                            if zone.config.onLeave then task.spawn(zone.config.onLeave, player) end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end)
    return self :: ProximitySystem
end
return ProximitySystem
```

```luau
--!strict

-- QuestTracker for racing game
-- Server-side warrior quest progress tracking

export type ObjectiveType = "Kill" | "Collect" | "Reach" | "Talk" | "Escort"
export type Objective = { id: string, type: ObjectiveType, target: string, required: number, description: string }
export type QuestDef = { id: string, name: string, description: string, objectives: {Objective}, rewards: {[string]: number} }
export type QuestProgress = { questId: string, objectiveProgress: {[string]: number}, isComplete: boolean, completedAt: number? }

export type QuestSystem = {
    StartQuest: (self: QuestSystem, player: Player, questId: string) -> boolean,
    UpdateProgress: (self: QuestSystem, player: Player, questId: string, objectiveId: string, amount: number) -> boolean,
    IsComplete: (self: QuestSystem, player: Player, questId: string) -> boolean,
    GetProgress: (self: QuestSystem, player: Player, questId: string) -> QuestProgress?,
    AbandonQuest: (self: QuestSystem, player: Player, questId: string) -> (),
    GetActiveQuests: (self: QuestSystem, player: Player) -> {QuestProgress},
}

type Internal = QuestSystem & { _defs: {[string]: QuestDef}, _progress: {[Player]: {[string]: QuestProgress}} }

local Impl = {}
Impl.__index = Impl

function Impl.StartQuest(self: Internal, player: Player, questId: string): boolean
    local def = self._defs[questId]; if not def then return false end
    if not self._progress[player] then self._progress[player] = {} end
    if self._progress[player][questId] then return false end
    local prog: {[string]: number} = {}; for _, obj in def.objectives do prog[obj.id] = 0 end
    self._progress[player][questId] = { questId = questId, objectiveProgress = prog, isComplete = false }
    return true
end

function Impl.UpdateProgress(self: Internal, player: Player, questId: string, objectiveId: string, amount: number): boolean
    local p = self._progress[player] and self._progress[player][questId]
    if not p or p.isComplete then return false end
    local def = self._defs[questId]; if not def then return false end
    for _, obj in def.objectives do
        if obj.id == objectiveId then
            p.objectiveProgress[objectiveId] = math.min((p.objectiveProgress[objectiveId] or 0) + amount, obj.required)
            break
        end
    end
    local allDone = true
    for _, obj in def.objectives do
        if (p.objectiveProgress[obj.id] or 0) < obj.required then allDone = false; break end
    end
    if allDone then p.isComplete = true; p.completedAt = os.time() end
    return true
end

function Impl.IsComplete(self: Internal, player: Player, questId: string): boolean
    local p = self._progress[player] and self._progress[player][questId]; return p ~= nil and p.isComplete
end

function Impl.GetProgress(self: Internal, player: Player, questId: string): QuestProgress?
    return self._progress[player] and self._progress[player][questId]
end

function Impl.AbandonQuest(self: Internal, player: Player, questId: string)
    local pp = self._progress[player]; if pp then pp[questId] = nil end
end

function Impl.GetActiveQuests(self: Internal, player: Player): {QuestProgress}
    local r: {QuestProgress} = {}; local pp = self._progress[player]
    if pp then for _, p in pp do if not p.isComplete then table.insert(r, p) end end end; return r
end

local QuestSystem = {}
function QuestSystem.new(quests: {[string]: QuestDef}): QuestSystem
    return setmetatable({ _defs = quests, _progress = {} }, Impl) :: any
end
return QuestSystem
```

```luau
--!strict

-- PriorityQueue for rogue scheduling in sandbox builder
-- Binary min-heap: O(log n) push/pop, O(1) peek

export type PriorityQueue<T> = {
    Push: (self: PriorityQueue<T>, value: T, priority: number) -> (),
    Pop: (self: PriorityQueue<T>) -> T?,
    Peek: (self: PriorityQueue<T>) -> T?,
    PeekPriority: (self: PriorityQueue<T>) -> number?,
    GetSize: (self: PriorityQueue<T>) -> number,
    IsEmpty: (self: PriorityQueue<T>) -> boolean,
    Clear: (self: PriorityQueue<T>) -> (),
}

type Entry<T> = { value: T, priority: number }
type Internal<T> = PriorityQueue<T> & { _heap: {Entry<T>}, _size: number }

local Impl = {}
Impl.__index = Impl

local function siftUp<T>(h: {Entry<T>}, i: number)
    while i > 1 do
        local p = math.floor(i / 2)
        if h[i].priority < h[p].priority then h[i], h[p] = h[p], h[i]; i = p else break end
    end
end

local function siftDown<T>(h: {Entry<T>}, n: number, i: number)
    while true do
        local s, l, r = i, i*2, i*2+1
        if l <= n and h[l].priority < h[s].priority then s = l end
        if r <= n and h[r].priority < h[s].priority then s = r end
        if s == i then break end
        h[i], h[s] = h[s], h[i]; i = s
    end
end

function Impl.Push<T>(self: Internal<T>, value: T, priority: number)
    self._size += 1
    self._heap[self._size] = { value = value, priority = priority }
    siftUp(self._heap, self._size)
end

function Impl.Pop<T>(self: Internal<T>): T?
    if self._size == 0 then return nil end
    local root = self._heap[1]
    self._heap[1] = self._heap[self._size]
    self._heap[self._size] = nil :: any
    self._size -= 1
    if self._size > 0 then siftDown(self._heap, self._size, 1) end
    return root.value
end

function Impl.Peek<T>(self: Internal<T>): T?
    if self._size == 0 then return nil end; return self._heap[1].value
end

function Impl.PeekPriority<T>(self: Internal<T>): number?
    if self._size == 0 then return nil end; return self._heap[1].priority
end

function Impl.GetSize<T>(self: Internal<T>): number return self._size end
function Impl.IsEmpty<T>(self: Internal<T>): boolean return self._size == 0 end
function Impl.Clear<T>(self: Internal<T>) table.clear(self._heap); self._size = 0 end

local PriorityQueue = {}
function PriorityQueue.new<T>(): PriorityQueue<T>
    return setmetatable({ _heap = {}, _size = 0 }, Impl) :: any
end
return PriorityQueue
```

```luau
    GetSubscriberCount: (self: EventBus, topic: string) -> number,
    Clear: (self: EventBus, topic: string?) -> (),
}

Impl.__index = Impl

function Impl.Publish(self: Internal, topic: string, ...: any)
    local subs = self._topics[topic]; if not subs then return end
    for cb in subs do task.spawn(cb, ...) end
end

function Impl.Subscribe(self: Internal, topic: string, callback: (...any) -> ()): Subscription
    if not self._topics[topic] then self._topics[topic] = {} end
    self._topics[topic][callback] = true
    return { Unsubscribe = function(_self: Subscription)
        local t = self._topics[topic]; if t then t[callback] = nil end
    end }
end

function Impl.Once(self: Internal, topic: string, callback: (...any) -> ()): Subscription
    local sub: Subscription
    local function wrapper(...: any) sub:Unsubscribe(); callback(...) end
    sub = self:Subscribe(topic, wrapper)
    return sub
end

function Impl.GetSubscriberCount(self: Internal, topic: string): number
    local subs = self._topics[topic]; if not subs then return 0 end
    local n = 0; for _ in subs do n += 1 end; return n
end

function Impl.Clear(self: Internal, topic: string?)
    if topic then self._topics[topic] = nil else table.clear(self._topics) end
end

local EventBus = {}
function EventBus.new(): EventBus
    return setmetatable({ _topics = {} }, Impl) :: any
end
return EventBus
```

```luau
end

    for i, a in c.actions do if a.name == name then table.remove(c.actions, i); return end end
end

end

    for _, c in self._conns do c:Disconnect() end
    table.clear(self._conns); table.clear(self._contexts); table.clear(self._stack)
end

local InputManager = {}

    local self: Internal = setmetatable({ _contexts = {}, _stack = {}, _keys = {}, _conns = {} }, Impl) :: any
    table.insert(self._conns, UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(inp, gp)
        if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then self._keys[inp.KeyCode] = true end
        if gp then return end
        local ctx = active(self); if not ctx then return end
        for _, a in ctx.actions do

        end
    end))
    table.insert(self._conns, UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(inp)
        if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then self._keys[inp.KeyCode] = false end
    end))
    return self :: InputManager
```

```luau
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

export type TweenConfig = { target: number, duration: number, easing: (t: number) -> number }
export type TweenHandle = { Cancel: (self: TweenHandle) -> (), IsActive: (self: TweenHandle) -> boolean }

export type TweenScheduler = {
    Tween: (self: TweenScheduler, startVal: number, config: TweenConfig, callback: (value: number) -> ()) -> TweenHandle,
    CancelAll: (self: TweenScheduler) -> (),
    GetActiveCount: (self: TweenScheduler) -> number,
    Destroy: (self: TweenScheduler) -> (),
}

type Entry = { start: number, target: number, duration: number, elapsed: number, easing: (t: number) -> number, callback: (number) -> (), active: boolean }
type Internal = TweenScheduler & { _tweens: {[TweenHandle]: Entry}, _conn: RBXScriptConnection? }

local Impl = {}
Impl.__index = Impl

function Impl.Tween(self: Internal, startVal: number, config: TweenConfig, callback: (number) -> ()): TweenHandle
    local entry: Entry = { start = startVal, target = config.target, duration = config.duration, elapsed = 0, easing = config.easing, callback = callback, active = true }
    local handle: any = { Cancel = function(h) entry.active = false; self._tweens[h] = nil end, IsActive = function() return entry.active end }
    self._tweens[handle] = entry
    if not self._conn then
        self._conn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt: number)
            local toRemove = {}
            for h, e in self._tweens do
                if not e.active then table.insert(toRemove, h); continue end
                e.elapsed += dt
                local t = math.clamp(e.elapsed / e.duration, 0, 1)
                e.callback(e.start + (e.target - e.start) * e.easing(t))
                if t >= 1 then e.active = false; table.insert(toRemove, h) end
            end
            for _, h in toRemove do self._tweens[h] = nil end
            if next(self._tweens) == nil and self._conn then (self._conn :: RBXScriptConnection):Disconnect(); self._conn = nil end
        end)
    end
    return handle :: TweenHandle
end

function Impl.CancelAll(self: Internal) for _, e in self._tweens do e.active = false end; table.clear(self._tweens) end
function Impl.GetActiveCount(self: Internal): number local n = 0; for _ in self._tweens do n += 1 end; return n end

function Impl.Destroy(self: Internal)
    self:CancelAll()
    if self._conn then (self._conn :: RBXScriptConnection):Disconnect(); self._conn = nil end
end

local TweenScheduler = {}
function TweenScheduler.new(): TweenScheduler
    return setmetatable({ _tweens = {}, _conn = nil }, Impl) :: any
end
return TweenScheduler
```

```luau
export type Leaderboard = {
    SetScore: (self: Leaderboard, player: Player, score: number) -> (),
    AddScore: (self: Leaderboard, player: Player, delta: number) -> number,
    GetScore: (self: Leaderboard, player: Player) -> number,
    GetTop: (self: Leaderboard, count: number) -> {Entry},
    GetRank: (self: Leaderboard, player: Player) -> number,
    Reset: (self: Leaderboard) -> (),
    Destroy: (self: Leaderboard) -> (),
}

Impl.__index = Impl

local function rebuild(self: Internal)
    local entries: {Entry} = {}
    for p, s in self._scores do table.insert(entries, { userId = p.UserId, playerName = p.Name, score = s, rank = 0 }) end
    table.sort(entries, function(a, b) return a.score > b.score end)
    for i, e in entries do e.rank = i end
    self._sorted = entries; self._dirty = false
end

function Impl.SetScore(self: Internal, player: Player, score: number) self._scores[player] = score; self._dirty = true end
function Impl.AddScore(self: Internal, player: Player, delta: number): number
    local new = (self._scores[player] or 0) + delta; self._scores[player] = new; self._dirty = true; return new
end
function Impl.GetScore(self: Internal, player: Player): number return self._scores[player] or 0 end

function Impl.GetTop(self: Internal, count: number): {Entry}
    if self._dirty or not self._sorted then rebuild(self) end
    local r: {Entry} = {}
    for i = 1, math.min(count, #(self._sorted :: {Entry})) do table.insert(r, (self._sorted :: {Entry})[i]) end
    return r
end

function Impl.GetRank(self: Internal, player: Player): number
    if self._dirty or not self._sorted then rebuild(self) end
    for _, e in self._sorted :: {Entry} do if e.userId == player.UserId then return e.rank end end; return -1
end

function Impl.Reset(self: Internal) table.clear(self._scores); self._sorted = nil; self._dirty = true end

function Impl.Destroy(self: Internal)
    for _, c in self._conns do c:Disconnect() end
    table.clear(self._conns); table.clear(self._scores)
end

local Leaderboard = {}
function Leaderboard.new(): Leaderboard
    local self: Internal = setmetatable({ _scores = {}, _sorted = nil, _dirty = true, _conns = {} }, Impl) :: any
    table.insert(self._conns, Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(p) self._scores[p] = nil; self._dirty = true end))
    return self :: Leaderboard
end
return Leaderboard
```

```luau
export type LockResult = { success: boolean, reason: string? }

export type SessionLock = {
    Acquire: (self: SessionLock, key: string) -> LockResult,
    Release: (self: SessionLock, key: string) -> boolean,
    IsLocked: (self: SessionLock, key: string) -> boolean,
    Refresh: (self: SessionLock, key: string) -> boolean,
    Destroy: (self: SessionLock) -> (),
}

type LockInfo = { serverId: string, acquiredAt: number, lastRefresh: number }
type Internal = SessionLock & { _locks: {[string]: LockInfo}, _serverId: string, _staleThreshold: number, _store: DataStore }

local Impl = {}
Impl.__index = Impl

function Impl.Acquire(self: Internal, key: string): LockResult
    local lockKey = "lock_" .. key
    local success, existing = pcall(function() return self._store:GetAsync(lockKey) end)
    if success and existing and typeof(existing) == "table" then
        if existing.serverId ~= self._serverId then
            local age = os.time() - (existing.acquiredAt or 0)
            if age < self._staleThreshold then return { success = false, reason = "Locked by another server" } end
        end
    end
    local lockData: LockInfo = { serverId = self._serverId, acquiredAt = os.time(), lastRefresh = os.time() }
    local ok = pcall(function() self._store:SetAsync(lockKey, lockData) end)
    if ok then self._locks[key] = lockData; return { success = true } end
    return { success = false, reason = "DataStore error" }
end

function Impl.Release(self: Internal, key: string): boolean
    self._locks[key] = nil; return pcall(function() self._store:RemoveAsync("lock_" .. key) end) :: boolean
end

function Impl.IsLocked(self: Internal, key: string): boolean return self._locks[key] ~= nil end

function Impl.Refresh(self: Internal, key: string): boolean
    local lock = self._locks[key]; if not lock then return false end
    lock.lastRefresh = os.time()
    return pcall(function() self._store:SetAsync("lock_" .. key, lock) end) :: boolean
end

function Impl.Destroy(self: Internal) table.clear(self._locks) end

local SessionLock = {}
function SessionLock.new(store: DataStore, serverId: string, staleThreshold: number?): SessionLock
    return setmetatable({ _locks = {}, _serverId = serverId, _staleThreshold = staleThreshold or 300, _store = store }, Impl) :: any
end
return SessionLock
```

```luau
--!strict

-- DamageTypeSystem for pirate adventure mech combat
-- Elemental blizzard damage with resistances

export type DamageType = "Physical" | "Fire" | "Ice" | "Lightning" | "Poison" | "Holy" | "Dark"
export type ResistanceTable = { [DamageType]: number }

export type DamageCalculation = {
    baseDamage: number, damageType: DamageType,
    finalDamage: number, resisted: number, isImmune: boolean,
}

export type DamageTypeSystem = {
    Calculate: (self: DamageTypeSystem, baseDamage: number, damageType: DamageType, resistances: ResistanceTable) -> DamageCalculation,
    SetResistance: (self: DamageTypeSystem, resistances: ResistanceTable, damageType: DamageType, value: number) -> (),
    GetResistance: (self: DamageTypeSystem, resistances: ResistanceTable, damageType: DamageType) -> number,
    CreateDefault: (self: DamageTypeSystem) -> ResistanceTable,
}

local Impl = {}
Impl.__index = Impl

function Impl.Calculate(self: any, baseDamage: number, damageType: DamageType, resistances: ResistanceTable): DamageCalculation
    local resist = resistances[damageType] or 0
    if resist >= 100 then
        return { baseDamage = baseDamage, damageType = damageType, finalDamage = 0, resisted = baseDamage, isImmune = true }
    end
    local multiplier = 1 - (resist / 100)
    local final = math.max(0, math.floor(baseDamage * multiplier))
    return { baseDamage = baseDamage, damageType = damageType, finalDamage = final, resisted = baseDamage - final, isImmune = false }
end

function Impl.SetResistance(self: any, resistances: ResistanceTable, damageType: DamageType, value: number)
    resistances[damageType] = math.clamp(value, -100, 100)
end

function Impl.GetResistance(self: any, resistances: ResistanceTable, damageType: DamageType): number
    return resistances[damageType] or 0
end

function Impl.CreateDefault(self: any): ResistanceTable
    return { Physical = 0, Fire = 0, Ice = 0, Lightning = 0, Poison = 0, Holy = 0, Dark = 0 }
end

local DamageTypeSystem = {}
function DamageTypeSystem.new()
    return setmetatable({}, Impl) :: any
end
return DamageTypeSystem
```

```luau
    IsPlayerInZone: (self: ProximitySystem, id: string, player: Player) -> boolean,
    GetPlayersInZone: (self: ProximitySystem, id: string) -> {Player},
    Destroy: (self: ProximitySystem) -> (),
}

local Impl = {}
Impl.__index = Impl

function Impl.CreateZone(self: Internal, id: string, config: ProximityConfig)
    self._zones[id] = { id = id, config = config, playersInRange = {} }
end

function Impl.RemoveZone(self: Internal, id: string) self._zones[id] = nil end

function Impl.IsPlayerInZone(self: Internal, id: string, player: Player): boolean
    local z = self._zones[id]; return z ~= nil and z.playersInRange[player] == true
end

function Impl.GetPlayersInZone(self: Internal, id: string): {Player}
    local z = self._zones[id]; if not z then return {} end
    local r: {Player} = {}; for p in z.playersInRange do table.insert(r, p) end; return r
end

function Impl.Destroy(self: Internal) self._conn:Disconnect(); table.clear(self._zones) end

local ProximitySystem = {}
function ProximitySystem.new(): ProximitySystem
    local self: Internal = setmetatable({ _zones = {}, _conn = nil :: any }, Impl) :: any
    self._conn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        for _, zone in self._zones do
            local rSq = zone.config.radius * zone.config.radius
            for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
                local char = player.Character
                if char then
                    local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    if root and root:IsA("BasePart") then
                        local d = zone.config.position - root.Position
                        local inRange = d:Dot(d) <= rSq
                        local wasInRange = zone.playersInRange[player] == true
                        if inRange and not wasInRange then
                            zone.playersInRange[player] = true
                            if zone.config.onEnter then task.spawn(zone.config.onEnter, player) end
                        elseif not inRange and wasInRange then
                            zone.playersInRange[player] = nil
                            if zone.config.onLeave then task.spawn(zone.config.onLeave, player) end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end)
    return self :: ProximitySystem
end
return ProximitySystem
```

```luau
--!strict

-- QuestTracker for sci-fi RPG
-- Server-side golem quest progress tracking

export type ObjectiveType = "Kill" | "Collect" | "Reach" | "Talk" | "Escort"
export type Objective = { id: string, type: ObjectiveType, target: string, required: number, description: string }
export type QuestDef = { id: string, name: string, description: string, objectives: {Objective}, rewards: {[string]: number} }
export type QuestProgress = { questId: string, objectiveProgress: {[string]: number}, isComplete: boolean, completedAt: number? }

export type QuestSystem = {
    StartQuest: (self: QuestSystem, player: Player, questId: string) -> boolean,
    UpdateProgress: (self: QuestSystem, player: Player, questId: string, objectiveId: string, amount: number) -> boolean,
    IsComplete: (self: QuestSystem, player: Player, questId: string) -> boolean,
    GetProgress: (self: QuestSystem, player: Player, questId: string) -> QuestProgress?,
    AbandonQuest: (self: QuestSystem, player: Player, questId: string) -> (),
    GetActiveQuests: (self: QuestSystem, player: Player) -> {QuestProgress},
}

type Internal = QuestSystem & { _defs: {[string]: QuestDef}, _progress: {[Player]: {[string]: QuestProgress}} }

local Impl = {}
Impl.__index = Impl

function Impl.StartQuest(self: Internal, player: Player, questId: string): boolean
    local def = self._defs[questId]; if not def then return false end
    if not self._progress[player] then self._progress[player] = {} end
    if self._progress[player][questId] then return false end
    local prog: {[string]: number} = {}; for _, obj in def.objectives do prog[obj.id] = 0 end
    self._progress[player][questId] = { questId = questId, objectiveProgress = prog, isComplete = false }
    return true
end

function Impl.UpdateProgress(self: Internal, player: Player, questId: string, objectiveId: string, amount: number): boolean
    local p = self._progress[player] and self._progress[player][questId]
    if not p or p.isComplete then return false end
    local def = self._defs[questId]; if not def then return false end
    for _, obj in def.objectives do
        if obj.id == objectiveId then
            p.objectiveProgress[objectiveId] = math.min((p.objectiveProgress[objectiveId] or 0) + amount, obj.required)
            break
        end
    end
    local allDone = true
    for _, obj in def.objectives do
        if (p.objectiveProgress[obj.id] or 0) < obj.required then allDone = false; break end
    end
    if allDone then p.isComplete = true; p.completedAt = os.time() end
    return true
end

function Impl.IsComplete(self: Internal, player: Player, questId: string): boolean
    local p = self._progress[player] and self._progress[player][questId]; return p ~= nil and p.isComplete
end

function Impl.GetProgress(self: Internal, player: Player, questId: string): QuestProgress?
    return self._progress[player] and self._progress[player][questId]
end

function Impl.AbandonQuest(self: Internal, player: Player, questId: string)
    local pp = self._progress[player]; if pp then pp[questId] = nil end
end

function Impl.GetActiveQuests(self: Internal, player: Player): {QuestProgress}
    local r: {QuestProgress} = {}; local pp = self._progress[player]
    if pp then for _, p in pp do if not p.isComplete then table.insert(r, p) end end end; return r
end

local QuestSystem = {}
function QuestSystem.new(quests: {[string]: QuestDef}): QuestSystem
    return setmetatable({ _defs = quests, _progress = {} }, Impl) :: any
end
return QuestSystem
```
